stem: If \(p = 25\) and \(q = 40\), the value of \(q\) is what percent greater than the value of \(p\)?

explanation.B: Incorrect. This divides the difference by \(q\) instead of \(p\): \(\frac{15}{40} = 37.5\%\). That is the percent by which \(p\) is less than \(q\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(q\) as a percent of \(p\), \(\frac{40}{25} = 160\%\), not the percent by which \(q\) is greater.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the difference, 15, written as a percent. It must be compared with \(p\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'C': 'A', 'B': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'A': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'C', 'B': 'B', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'A'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
v = Rational(40 - 25, 25)
assert v == Rational(60, 100)
assert value(choices[answer]) == v
assert all(value(choices[k]) != v for k in choices if k != answer)
